newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokeswoman Barbara Nolan said former Commission Vice-President Etienne Davignon would hold a news conference with Commissioners Padraig Flynn and Mario Monti on Tuesday at 1215/1015 GMT. She said Davignon would present a report by the labour experts group whose aim was to break the deadlocks such as the one on the European company statute. Nolan said Davignon was likely to have found new solutions that meet the different views on how workers should be involved in companies.

In answer to a question spokesman Gerry Kiely said Commissioner Franz Fischler had met Britain's new Agriculture Minister Jack Cunningham in the morning. He said they had discussed the future common agricultural policy (CAP) reform, bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE) and a lifting of the EU ban on British beef exports.
The Commission released the following documents:
- Memo/97/50: Euro-Mediterranean partnership: implementation of the multilateral aspects of the Barcelona Declaration.
- Eurostat news release No 34/97: EU annual inflation falls to 1.7% in March.
- Eurostat - Quarterly national accounts ESA No 1-1997: Third quarter 1996.
